breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that beta must be computed using the absolute (Kelvin) film temperature, not Celsius. The generated specification explicitly states 'β as the reciprocal of the absolute film temperature in kelvin, β ≈ 1/323 K⁻¹', which matches the ground truth requirement of beta ≈ 1/T_abs evaluated at the film temperature in Kelvin (323 K).
